WITH wk AS (SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')),
s AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) train, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) web
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(x.refund_net) ret_all, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=999 THEN x.refund_net ELSE 0 END) ret_train, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN x.refund_net ELSE 0 END) ret_web, count(*) nret, count(DISTINCT x.return_line_id) ndist
  FROM fact_return_line x JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date=x.return_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=x.store_key GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(q.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(q.returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(q.net_sales) rpt_net, count(DISTINCT q.store_id) nstores, sum(CASE WHEN q.store_id=999 THEN q.net_sales ELSE 0 END) rpt_train, sum(CASE WHEN q.store_id=900 THEN q.net_sales ELSE 0 END) rpt_web
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date=q.business_date GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT * FROM s JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) JOIN p USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY fiscal_week, fiscal_year

 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.sales_line_id END) lines_with_return

JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key AND st.store_id=900

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')),
sales AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(x.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line x JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = x.return_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1,2),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week))
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
  round(t.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_this_year, round(l.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_last_year,
  round((t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net t JOIN net l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
